notes.title: Patch 0.19.0 - Curveball
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Here comes the patch for the upcoming playtest weekend!  

We've made some impactful changes that should add more freedom and depth to the gameplay. We’re excited to hear your feedback!  

• UPDATED ABILITY  
   
   Dash  
      
      Now has 3 charges.  
      If a player deflects while dashing, the ball will curve in the direction of the dash.  
      
   

• NEW MECHANIC  
   
   Ball curving  
      
      Players can now curve the ball by deflecting while dashing:  
         
         Dash left → Ball curves left  
         Dash right → Ball curves right  
         Dash forward → Deflects harder forward  
         Dash backward → Temporarily slows down the ball  
         
      
   

   Dev note: The ball will still target the player you’re looking at, but if you dash left while deflecting, it will curve left toward your target.  

   Dev note 2: This is our first iteration of ball curving. We have more ideas for refining the mechanic, but we’d love your feedback before making further changes! [THANKS EMOTE]  

• VFX  
   
   New kill markers added:  
      
      Gravestone  
      Flower  
      Trash Can  
      
   

   Dev note: These kill markers are tied to player level progression and can be unlocked by playing.  

• Bug Fixes  
   
   Fixed an issue where players retained velocity from the lobby when spawning into the arena.  
   Fixed an issue with the sprint animation.  
   Fixed a bug where Mega Jump VFX could spawn multiple times.  
   Fixed some sound issues related to sudden death.

notes.title: 0.13.0 - "Sudden Death"
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

After an extensive internal playtest, we've gathered valuable data and insightful feedback. And we're excited to bring you a significant update! This patch features a range of balance adjustments and tweaks, along with some exciting new mechanics to elevate your experience.

Here are some of the key issues we identified and how we've addressed them:
Issue: Games can go on for too long.
    Fix: We've introduced a *Sudden Death* mechanic to keep things fast-paced and thrilling.
Issue: New players dying too quickly and spending most of their time spectating other players.
    Fix: We've adjusted the ball's speed curve — it now accelerates more gradually and becomes more dynamic toward the end of the round. This should make the early game more manageable for newcomers.
    Looking Ahead:
        To further address this issue, we're planning to implement a ranking system. This will help match new players with others at a similar skill level, reducing the chances of them being knocked out too quickly and ensuring they get more time to play and improve.
Issue: Some abilities, like Hot Potato, felt too powerful and rarely on cooldown.
   Fix: We've rebalanced all abilities and deflect mechanics to improve overall fairness.      
Stay tuned, and we hope you enjoy the improvements!

Change log:

Ball
 Intercepting the ball will not change the balls target.
  Intercept = Deflecting the ball when its targeting someone else
The ball now accelerates more gradually at the start of a round
Settings 
Added separate sensitivity options for Controllers
 Added Deadzone settings for Controllers

Ability Balance
Deflect Deflect duration 1.3s -> 1s.
   Deflect failed CD 3s->2.5s.
    Perfect deflect impulse increase 20%-60%.
     Time to get perfect hit changed from 0.2s to 0.05s.
Hotpotato
     Hotpotato CD changed 10s -> 35s.
     Increased stack size change on Hotpotato from 100cm to 250cm per stack
Upwards smash
    Upwards smash ammo 3 -> 1.
    Change CD on upward smash 10s -> 8s.
Mimic Ball
    Mimic ball ammo 2 -> 1
Power Boost
     Power boost deflect impulse increase 200% -> 150%
Place bomb
     Changed Cd on place bomb from 10s -> 20s
     Placed bomb cast time 0.3s -> 0.1s
Place jump pad
     Placed jump pad cast time 0.3s -> 0.1s
Yoyo
     Yoyo cast time 0.5s -> 0.2s
Redirect
    Redirect cast time 0.2s -> 0.1s
Sudden Death
We've implemented a Sudden Death mechanic across all arenas. However, we're already prototyping a variety of sudden death mechanics to keep end-game moments exciting and unpredictable. Our goal is to create a diverse set of mechanics, so each round feels fresh and intense.

Sudden Death General
    Dynamic Sudden Death Timer
(The sudden death timer becomes adaptive, starting sooner as more players are eliminated.)
Default Sudden Death Start: 2 minutes
        Time Reduction per Player Elimination: 20 seconds            
Sudden Death Mechanic
    One Life Sudden Death
        (When sudden death begins, all players are set to just 1 life. Additionally, life and cooldown reduction pickups are removed from the arena, creating a high-stakes showdown.)
BUGS
 Resolved media lag in videos explaining how abilities work.
 Fixed several navigation bugs in the main menu when using a controller.
 Spectator camera now behaves consistently with the normal game camera.
 Properly capped FPS on the splash screen to improve performance.
 Fixed a bug where bombs placed on Rumble Rafts would land on the ocean floor instead of the water surface.
 Addressed an Issue allowing players to escape the lobby and jump beneath the level.
 Resolved multiple issues with matchmaking and the party system.
 Fixed a bug that prevented players from being teleported back to the lobby after a game.

notes.title: Patch 0.12.0 - "CRT-15"
notes.content:
Main Menu
 Improved controller support.
 Increased lobby capacity to support 6 players.
 Friend codes are now hidden by default when opening the Friend window.
 Updated visuals in the "Invite to Party" window.

Characters
 Reworking in-game characters and introducing the robot CRT-15 as the new default character.

Ball
 The ball can now scale to infinite speed.
 Reworked the ball's trail: it now alternates only between white and red.
(White: Player is not the ball's target.)
(Red: Player is the ball's target.)
 Improved targeting mechanics: the ball now attempts to intercept its target, reducing random orbiting.

UI
 The crosshair now provides feedback on the duration of the deflect ability and its cooldown.
 Abilities that use ammo now display an effect on both the ability icon and the deflect indicator while ammo is remaining.

Arenas
 Temporarily disabled the Everest Arena due to collision and readability issues.
(Planning a rework for the Everest Arena.)
 Fixed a collision issue on the Rumble Rafts Arena where players could get stuck under a platform and die in the water.

VFX
 Added a shield VFX that appears around the player character when "Deflect" is active.
 Added new VFX when a player takes damage.
 Updated the "Perfect Deflect" text effect.

Misc
 Added new loading screens.
 Increased the emote limit from 3 to 5.
 Removed old assets and reworked level progression with updated assets.
 Removed character collision for the player's camera, allowing it to move behind other players.
 Introduced a soft currency cap of 6,000 bits.
 Reduced time between rounds.

Bugs
 Fixed an issue where "Screen Hack" would not affect the targeted player but would still go on cooldown.
 Removed the ghost third player on podiums when playing in duos.
 Fixed an issue where other players would not see the "Yoyo" VFX.

notes.title: Patch 0.11.0 - "New ball new me"
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've got an early holiday gift for you! 🎁

As highlighted in our previous patch notes, we've been hard at work reworking some of the game's core systems. Both the ball mechanics and the ability system have been completely overhauled, rebuilt from the ground up with new systems. Today, we're excited to roll out these updates for you to test.

Our goal is for these new systems to deliver smoother and more reliable gameplay while enhancing the overall experience. That said, as with any major changes, there's always the chance of new bugs sneaking in.

Please keep in mind that these systems are still a work-in-progress. We'll continue refining and improving them in future updates.

Thank you for your patience and enthusiasm

Enjoy!

Ball and Ability systems
Enabled the new ball system.
Disabled the old ball system.
Enabled the new GAS-driven Ability System.
Disabled the old Ability System.

Abilities
Reenabled the "Jump Pad" ability.

Weapons
Updated icons/screenshots.

Animations
Added winning animations for the round winner podium:
Crossed Arms
Thumbs Up
Loser Pose

Round Beats
Weapons have been removed from the podium.

Levels
Began development on a new upcoming arena.

Controller Support (Main Menu)
Started work on adding controller support for the main menu.

VFXAll abilities have been ported to the new system.

Bug Fixes
Fixed visual glitches on Arena 1.
Fixed an issue with audio sliders when using a controller.
Fixed an issue with the ball's pathfinding.
Fixed an issue where players could get stuck and become unable to use any input.
Fixed an issue where players could use placeable abilities after dying if the ability was started before death.
Fixed an issue where the game would start in a small window in the corner of the screen.
(This may cause a brief visual effect when the game starts; we are actively working on a better fix.)
Fixed an issue where players could spectate other "dead" players.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.0 “Artsy Patch”
notes.content:
Hey everyone,  

This patch we have been hard at work overhauling a bunch of core systems, though it’s not quite there yet. For now, we’re delivering a very “artsy” patch, featuring overhauled skins and levels, along with several balance changes and other goodies.  

Enjoy!  

Balance  
Dev Note: Players often put themselves in potentially risky positions when trying to reach pickups. The goal is to make cooldown reduction pickups rewarding enough to justify the risk. With these changes, the pickup will guarantee that players can use their dash immediately after collecting it, and it will also have a greater impact on other abilities that are on cooldown.  

- Increased cooldown reduction pickup value from 2 to 4 seconds.  
- Decreased the Dash cooldown from 6 to 4 seconds.  
- Spectate Camera  
    - Added Zoom in/out with scroll wheel.  
    - Track ball with Q.  
    - Change camera modes with Hotkey 1, 2, and 3.  
    - Added Ball Freelook camera and Ball First Person camera.  
    - Arena cameras.  
- Level Up Rewards.  

UI  
- Character portraits are now correctly displayed in the result screens.  
- Dropped-out players are cached in match results.  
- Fixed odd scalings on the Main Menu.  

VFX  
- Pickups are now animated and have visual effects.  

Controller Support  
- Fixed dead zone on controller for look movement.  
- Controller now works in matches.  

Characters  
- All default characters have received overhauled skins.  

Main Menu  
- Reworked lighting in the Main Menu.  

Levels  
- Falling out of bounds no longer results in death; instead, you lose 1 HP.  
- Arena 2 received a total rework:  
    - New environment.  
    - New rafts.  

Pickups  
- Fixed pickup spawn positions.  

Weapons  
- Overhauled all base weapons:  
    - Baseball Bat.  
    - Cricket Bat.  
    - Hockey Stick.  
    - Tennis Racket.  
- Baguette received a facelift (chonky).  
- Added a new variation of the Guitar (Black).  

Bug Fixes  
- Main Menu now works properly after accessing Loadout.  
- Fixed Ball Camera.  
- Fixed Hot Potato.

notes.title: Patch 0.5.0 “Work in Progress”
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’ve been hard at work updating our existing systems and adding some new features. While these are still in progress, we felt it was important to get a new stable build out for testing.

So, here’s a fresh “stable” build for you! As the patch notes suggest, this update includes several work-in-progress systems and features. We’ve also made some under-the-hood changes to how certain things operate, so you might encounter some breakages along the way. 🙂

We appreciate your testing and feedback!

Party System and matchmaking


 You can now invite your Steam friends to your lobby and queue up together.
 We now display how many players are currently in the queue.


Loadout


 We’ve begun work on how abilities are equipped:

 The UI now displays a hotbar of abilities. To equip an ability, simply select an ability you own and then choose the slot in the hotbar where you want it equipped.

 We have added a bunch of color variations to existing skins
 Several new weapons and weapon variations


Gameplay


 You can now use a select amount of abilities in the Spectators lobby
 We've made adjustments to how certain abilities function. Now, you’ll see a projectile being thrown from the player towards the target position. Currently, the projectile travels very slowly, but we’ll speed it up in a future update.
 Reworked and added visual effects (VFX) for abilities that were missing them.
 Game state improvements:

 Podium for match/round winner
 Clearer beats when the match is changing states



Optimizations


 All arenas have undergone an optimization pass for better performance.
 Added a precompiler of Shaders to reduce in-game stuttering.


Camera


 We've added a system that hides objects between your camera and character, so you should no longer have a face full of grass when looking up in the Bamboo Forest arena.


Bots


 Bots have been improved and will no longer clump together in the middle of the arena.
 Their reaction times have been enhanced, making them better at deflecting the ball.
 Bots are now able to dash.


Menu


 New Main Menu UI has been implemented (skin variations)
 Saving game settings to lootlocker


Website


 Website has been created and made public


Abilities


 Bomb visuals
 Mega Jump visuals
 Double Jump visuals

notes.title: Friends & Family Stable 1 Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and thank you again for playing and helping us test MLC. Here are our very first patch notes for you. A lot of the changes were made based on the feedback we got from you. The notes don’t include all the changes there are several performance, audio, art, & gameplay changes, so jump in and see what else we did.

UNIQUE DEV WEAPON SKIN
There is currently a unique weapon skin, the 'Ban Hammer,' in the game for developers. You have to start the game to get it added to your profile, so don't forget to jump in and play. Only developers and very early testers will have access to this skin, so don't miss out on getting yours! :D

If you jump in and play, please give us more feedback through Discord. We have updated the Discord app for feedback and bug forms, so you are no longer redirected of the Discord app. Hopefully, this makes it easier for everyone to submit feedback there!

Patch notes:
New Content:
Weapon skins

 Rainbow versions of the Katana, Spear, &  Hammer
 New Exclusive BAN hammer skin, (This will only be given out during the company test period and friends and family test period)

Character skins

Several new color variations of the default player characters

 Mr. Jello
 TV Robot with in 3 variations


Emote wheel

You can now open a early version of our emote wheel by pressing E,

move your mouse to the emote you want to send and let go of E.


Note: The emote wheel currently only works with mouse and keyboard.

Settings menu

There is now a settings menu where you can lower the graphical settings to better match what your system can handle
There is now a settings menu for Audio Settings as well.
Able to access settings in game.

Loadout

Ability Tags

In the loadout there are now Tags on every ability, hovering over these will give you more information on how an ability works

Ability Gifs

All abilities now have a short gif showing how the work


Ability changes

VFX and Feedback pass

Several abilities have gotten updates to their feedback and VFX

Screen hack <3

Screen hack is now a amiable ability, and only hacks the person you are looking at when you activate the ability.
Increased CD

Yoyo <3

Yoyo can now be casted at anytime even if you were not the last player to touch the ball
Yoyo now has a short cast time to make it harder to use when standing very close to someone

Mimic

More feedback and brand new VFX to make it easier for player to spot which balls are fake


Changes marked with <3 where made based on your feedback!

Bugfixes

Fixed so players can’t escape the lobby on several levels
Fixed so you cant escape and hide from the ball on Nepal
Fixed and issue where Pressing Q while in spectate would crash the game
Fixed the ball missing its mesh when joining late
Fixed discord button
Fixed ball getting stuck inside players
Fixed Players getting hit and deflecting at the same time
Fixed Speedboost ability feeling laggy/jittery
Fixed Player getting hacked by the Screenhack ability while in the lobby
Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in menus
And many more fixes! :D
